title: ارائه نمونه نهایی و تأیید اولیه گزارش
englishTitle: Final sample presentation and initial report acceptance
acceptanceCriteria: فایل و نسخه و نتیجه بازبینی ارقام و صفحه‌بندی نگهداری شود. (Preserve file, version/SHA, and review results of numbers, figures, and pagination with explicit employer sign-off minute).

personasEvaluated.persona: Employer / Client Representative (نماینده عالی کارفرما و دستگاه نظارت)
personasEvaluated.summary: No frozen Phase A.1 release archive exists with fixed commit SHA, signed golden fixtures, sample exports (Excel/PDF), and verified SHA-256 checksums. Live /delivery-plan strictly redirects unauthenticated requests to login, while authenticated inspection reveals A.1.04 remains in 'remaining' status. No employer walkthrough protocol or signed acceptance minute has been recorded; employer disposition remains strictly pending.

personasEvaluated.persona: Independent Auditor / QA Engineer (بازرس مستقل کیفیت و داده)
personasEvaluated.summary: Hard dependency blockage: upstream deliverables A.1.02 and A.1.03 (and package B05) have unresolved critical defects, including missing formula cached values in Excel, lack of independent headless recalculation verification, and absence of visual regression logs. Negative cross-project isolation tests for direct-ID download endpoints (E09) lack documented live execution proofs on the candidate build.

personasEvaluated.persona: Field Engineer / Report Preparer (سرپرست کارگاه و مسئول تهیه گزارش)
personasEvaluated.summary: Complete bilingual (FA RTL / EN LTR) and responsive viewport (390x844 mobile vs desktop) evidence across all 18 daily report sections is not formally packaged for this candidate. Decision tree (docs/decision-tree/) has not been reconciled against deployed export authorization gates.

defects.title: Missing frozen Phase A.1 release bundle with commit SHA, independent inputs/expected fixtures, final sample exports, and verified SHA-256 checksums
defects.evidence: No frozen package exists under output/ or specs/ for Phase A.1 (last delivery archive is output/a7-delivery-2026-11-16/).

defects.title: Hard dependency block: upstream delivery tasks A.1.02 and A.1.03 have open blocker defects
defects.evidence: A.1.02 and A.1.03 have unresolved defects (missing Excel formula caches, lack of standalone recalculation tests, unmeasured download latencies, and missing visual regression logs).

defects.title: Missing explicit employer review protocol and walkthrough minutes
defects.evidence: Project governance mandates that automated tests or agents cannot sign on behalf of the employer. No employer review minutes or sign-off decision is recorded; employer acceptance remains strictly pending.

defects.title: Unverified live cross-project isolation matrix and negative security tests for direct ID download endpoints
defects.evidence: Live execution evidence proving non-member or unauthorized direct-ID download denial across projects is not formally packaged.

defects.title: Incomplete mobile responsive (390x844) and bilingual (FA/EN) verification evidence across all 18 daily report sections
defects.evidence: Full journey audit on mobile viewports (390x844) and English locale is not archived with the candidate release.

defects.title: Decision tree in docs/decision-tree/ lacks final verification against deployed authorization gates and export routes
defects.evidence: Decision tree routes need live validation once release deployment is frozen.
